thread:
Elena: Reposting a focused follow-up from todays all-hands  we had strong signal around customer wins/losses; opening this thread to lock owners and short-term next steps.
Marco: Summary of the signals I captured: wins = Dedicated latency/SLAs and clear pricing for reserved capacity; losses = Private onboarding churn, pricing surprises during scale, and missing integration playbooks.
Priya: FWIW, three recent losses called out unpredictable KMS/network validation time. Customers said it felt like an "integration black box." They asked for an explicit smoke-test flow.
Jun: I'll build a tiny smoke-test script (curl + KMS healthcheck) and a checklist with expected timings. Will drop a gist and ping Docs. ETA 5 business days.
Sam: Sales ask: can we ship a simple pricing estimator (range-based) for prospects so they stop assuming worst-case token costs? Even roughs would help.
Ava: GTM here  yes please. Also want a 1-page rebuttal deck with three common cost objection scripts + numbers to share in calls.
Marco: I'll take the estimator + deck. Proposal: estimator = interactive spreadsheet + two canned examples; rebuttal deck = two slides. ETA 10 days.
Priya: Also request a small redacted case note showing a Hosted->Dedicated migration outcome (latency and cost before/after). That story converts.
Maya: I can redact and share a short blurb from the onboarding tracker by EOW.
Elena: Good. Operational ask: Rev Ops should tag lost deals in CRM with primary loss reason (cost/integration/security/feature) and auto-post a 1-paragraph summary to #product-weekly. Sarah volunteered earlier.
Ava: That routing would close the feedback loop nicely. We can triage in GTM/Product sync and propose roadmap changes quickly.
Jun: On docs: will add the validation checklist + a minimal VPC peering example and link to the KMS smoke-test. Docs owner, please ack (tag: @docs-team).
Sam: Tiny extra: include p50/p95 examples by model family on the one-pager so expectations are explicit.
Marco: Yes  will include p50/p95 ranges and a note on how batching affects latency/cost.
ops-bot: Created task #5140 "AH follow-up: Prospect estimator & onboarding smoke-tests" assigned to Marco, Jun. Due 2026-04-20.
Elena: Action recap (short): Jun = smoke-test + checklist (5bd), Marco = estimator + rebuttal deck + perf numbers (10bd), Maya = redacted case note (3bd), Rev Ops/Sarah = CRM tagging automation, Docs = publish quickstart links. We'll review status in next all-hands.
Ava: GTM will do rapid review (24-48h) once drafts are up.
Priya: Thanks  closing loop here makes our sales motion much stronger.
Elena: Thanks everyone, marking this thread as canonical follow-up for wins/losses asks.
